column1: # Court of Appeals of Indiana, "Map of Court Districts": which of the three
# geographic districts each county is in, READ FROM THE COURT'S OWN MAP IMAGE,
# The court publishes the districts' counties only as this picture, and the
# statute that sets them could not be read (see README.md). Method: each
# county's shaded region was segmented out of the image, the image was
# georeferenced to the shipped county fabric by an affine fit, and each
# region was matched one-to-one to a county; 91 of 92 matched, and Posey,
# whose region the segmentation did not separate, is surrounded by District
# One on the map. Every county was then checked by eye against the map's
# printed county names and its legend: 52 District One, 19 District Two and
# 20 District Three, plus Posey in District One. Districts Four and Five
# include every county and are not in this file.
# County (as the fabric's BASENAME spells it), a tab, then its district.
